notes.title: HandyGames AI-Powered Showcase 2024
notes.content:
HandyGames is thrilled to announce the first-ever AI-powered HandyGames Showcase 2024, which will be part of the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2024. The event will kick off on August 2nd, 2024, at 8:45 PM CEST. Gaming enthusiasts can tune in to watch the full showcase on the [url=https://showcase.thqnordic.com/]THQ Nordic Showcase Page[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/thqnordic]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/thqnordic]Twitch[/url], or view the HandyGames Showcase separately on the official HandyGames [url=https://youtu.be/ve2uYMwXpYo]YouTube[/url] channel. Prepare for a showcase crafted with the precision of an AI-driven algorithm versus the creativity of a caffeinated game dev.

[previewyoutube=D2TiwAk4sMs;full][/previewyoutube]

Join us as we reveal more about our exciting titles and celebrate the creativity and innovation in gaming. We have programmed our AI to ensure it's an unforgettable experience. So, sit back, relax, and let our artificial intelligence entertain you like never before.

Stay tuned for more updates and be prepared to welcome our new AI Overlords!

notes.title: Steam Awards
notes.content:
It's that time of year! The Steam Awards are just around the corner, and it's up to you, the players, to nominate your favorite games of 2022. From all your excellent feedback, we know that you enjoyed Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader, and we're confident that it is one of the most entertaining and challenging quiz show experiences out there. So if you would consider nominating Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader for a Steam Award, we'd be very humbled.

Thank you so much for your continued support from everyone at HandyGames and Massive Miniteam.
